# Zodiac Legal — Advocates & Corporate Counsel (Lucknow, Uttar Pradesh, India)

> Zodiac Legal is a corporate, commercial, real estate (UP-RERA), and dispute resolution law practice based in Vikas Nagar, Lucknow, Uttar Pradesh, India. We advise companies, startups, promoters, creditors, and property owners across Uttar Pradesh on corporate governance, commercial contracts, UP-RERA, domestic arbitration, insolvency (NCLT Allahabad), debt recovery (DRT Lucknow & Section 138 NI Act), intellectual property, labour compliance, and taxation/consumer redressal.

## Entity & NAP Details
- **Legal Entity / Practice Name:** Zodiac Legal (Associated in regional directory records with Shashwat Global Services)
- **Office Location:** Vikas Nagar, Lucknow, Uttar Pradesh – 226022, India
- **Telephone / WhatsApp:** +91 98390 10163
- **Electronic Mail:** contact@zodiaclegal.com
- **Consultation Hours:** Monday – Saturday, 10:00 AM – 7:00 PM IST (By prior appointment)
- **Primary Jurisdictions Covered:** High Court of Judicature at Allahabad (Lucknow Bench), Commercial Courts (Lucknow), NCLT Allahabad Bench, DRT Lucknow, UP-RERA (Lucknow), State & District Consumer Commissions (UP), ROC Kanpur, and MSEFC (UP).
- **Bar Council Compliance:** Maintained in strict adherence to Rule 36 of the Bar Council of India Rules. Informational only; not legal advice or solicitation.

## Core Practice Area Pages
- [Practice Areas Overview](https://zodiaclegal.com/practice-areas/): Complete index of transactional, regulatory, and litigation desks.
- [Corporate & Commercial Law](https://zodiaclegal.com/practice-areas/corporate-commercial/): Companies Act 2013 governance, entity incorporation (ROC Kanpur), shareholder agreements, and joint ventures.
- [Contracts & Commercial Agreements](https://zodiaclegal.com/practice-areas/contracts-agreements/): Drafting, vetting, and negotiation of MSAs, SLAs, NDAs, vendor contracts, and UP e-stamp compliance.
- [Startups & Regulatory Compliance](https://zodiaclegal.com/practice-areas/startups-compliance/): Incorporation, founders' equity vesting, DPIIT Startup India recognition, and annual ROC compliance.
- [Dispute Resolution & Arbitration](https://zodiaclegal.com/practice-areas/dispute-resolution-arbitration/): Domestic arbitration under the 1996 Act, Commercial Courts Act 2015 litigation, and civil recovery.
- [Real Estate & UP-RERA](https://zodiaclegal.com/practice-areas/real-estate-rera/): 30-year chain-of-title searches in Lucknow, commercial leases, conveyance deeds, and UP-RERA allottee/promoter representation.
- [Banking, Finance, NCLT & DRT](https://zodiaclegal.com/practice-areas/banking-finance-nclt-drt/): IBC Section 7/9 insolvency petitions (NCLT Allahabad), SARFAESI proceedings (DRT Lucknow), and Section 138 NI Act cheque dishonour litigation.
- [Intellectual Property](https://zodiaclegal.com/practice-areas/intellectual-property/): Trademark search, TM-A filing, Section 9/11 examination replies, oppositions, and copyright registration.
- [Employment & Labour Law](https://zodiaclegal.com/practice-areas/employment-labour/): Employment contracts, Section 27 Contract Act covenants, POSH Act compliance, and UP Shops & Commercial Establishments Act 1962 filings.
- [Taxation, GST & Consumer Redressal](https://zodiaclegal.com/practice-areas/taxation-regulatory/): GST show-cause notice replies (Sec 73/74), MSME Samadhaan recovery, and Consumer Protection Act 2019 proceedings.
